column1: # ESP32-C6 — 16 MiB flash: dual OTA (HTTP / BLE) + stm32_fw partition.
# Boot often reports "Detected size(16384k)" with a 4MB header — set
# CONFIG_ESPTOOLPY_HEADER_FLASHSIZE_UPDATE so esptool/header match the chip.
# After switching from "factory-only" to OTA: recommended first write
# (or at least rewrite the partition table + both OTA slots). `idf.py flash` loads
# the app into ota_0 (no factory partition).
# Backup of factory-only layout on 4 MB: partitions_4mb_factory_only.csv
# Small firmware + dual OTA on 4 MB: partitions_4mb_dual_ota.csv (limited app size).
